Cells of One Type inside a Field, Ranked

Source: R/figure-data-images.R
FieldCellsRanked.Rd

Selects cells with given labels inside a square of half-width half around a centre, ordered by a column (for example the distance to the nearest tumour cell), and keeps the first n; used to place arrows on a fluorescence field.

Usage

FieldCellsRanked(
  cells,
  centre,
  half,
  labels,
  order_by = NULL,
  n = Inf,
  x = "x",
  y = "y",
  label = "label"
)

Arguments

cells

Data frame of cells.

centre

c(x, y) or a data frame with x, y.

half

Half-width of the square.

labels

Labels of the cells to select.

order_by

Optional column to sort by (ascending).

n

Maximum number of cells.

x, y, label

Column names.

Value

The selected rows of cells.

Examples

d <- data.frame(x = c(1, 2, 3, 9), y = c(1, 1, 2, 9), label = c("a", "a", "b", "a"),
                dist = c(4, 2, 1, 3))
FieldCellsRanked(d, centre = c(2, 2), half = 3, labels = "a", order_by = "dist")
#>   x y label dist
#> 1 2 1     a    2
#> 2 1 1     a    4
